info.title: tsipam address-space registry API
info.description: Plans and allocates Tailscale address space through 4via6 site IDs, subnet CIDR pools, per-service IPv4 addresses, and per-device UDP listen ports. Paths are tailnet-scoped (/tailnet/{tailnet}/ipam/...) to mirror Tailscale's own control-plane API convention.
